description: HP-58 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Manali subdivision in Himachal Pradesh. It was established to manage vehicle registrations and licensing for the high-traffic tourist hub of Manali, operating under the jurisdiction of the Regional Transport Office (RTO) Kullu.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Manali, District Kullu, Himachal Pradesh - 175131
